milestones.title: MVP 0 — Product decisions and contracts
milestones.description: Ratify decision records and canonical data/state/authority contracts. Ready-for-plan is not implementation approval. No invented due date.

milestones.title: MVP 1 — Frontend journey alignment
milestones.description: A complete stateful, explicitly sample-backed Initiative-to-outcome journey with desktop/mobile/role/failure evidence. Not live integration.

milestones.title: MVP 2 — Backend product foundations
milestones.description: Persist and enforce agreed contracts, permissions, calculations, controlled decisions, actual outcomes and history. Can proceed by domain once contracts are accepted.

milestones.title: MVP 3 — Connected pilot and release proof
milestones.description: Reviewed live adapters, selected pilot integration and multi-user release evidence. No fixture fallback; all mandatory dispositions and release gates reconciled.

issues.title: Ratify product decisions and PRD dispositions
issues.outcome: Record D-01–08 with accountable decider, accepted option, rationale, affected requirements and explicit expected/optional deferrals. The report is accepted; unresolved role/AI/pilot choices are not silently settled.
acceptance: Given conflicting older CEO guidance and the replacement PRD, when the decision is ratified, then affected role/AI/workflow scope and mandatory consequences are recorded.
Given an unresolved decision, then dependent implementation remains blocked; an agent may draft options but cannot invent the answer.
issues.decisionGate: D-01–08 as applicable; drafting is allowed, ratification remains human.
nonGoals: No new repository or unrelated redesign.
No production writes, permission grants, deployment or automatic merge.
No fixture behaviour labelled live; preserve live-adapter release gates.
No arbitrary connectors, unrestricted automation or AI decision authority.

acceptance: Given Draft v1, submitting/deciding still concerns v1; material replacement creates v2 and prior authority does not transfer.
Given contextual money, record identity/basis/unit/currency/time and ambiguity survive every boundary.
Given cross-service implementation, contract and migration compatibility are accepted before dependent runtime edits.
